hook: Your spacesuit helmet can fill with water in space.
title: An Astronaut's Helmet Filled With Water
description:
In 2013, water flooded the helmet of astronaut Luca Parmitano during a spacewalk outside the International Space Station. It pooled around his head and covered his eyes and nose, and he had to rush back inside. He made it back safely. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Space #Astronaut
